contentText:
Karol G’s “BbY WOW” continues to stay on top for a seventh week, while Omar Courtz sees a new peak with “Koko,” while Natanael Cano, Tito Double P, Victor Mendivil and Ovi earn a spot in the top 10 with “Olivia La Flaka.”

Narrator: Here’s the Billboard Hot Latin Songs top 10 for the week dated Oct. 10! “Polvo Rosita” kicks off the countdown at No. 10, “Olivia La Flaka” is new at No. 9, “De Lejitos” stays put at eight, as does “Matadora” at seven. LATIN MAFIA and Fred again.. slide to six, “Ayudame” holds firm at five, while “Koko” climbs to four. “Ahi” is strong a three, as is “DTMF” at two. And “BbY WOW” remains on top for a seventh week at No. 1!
